entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding with VeloFit. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi, Isaac. I hope you can help. I'm having a problem with my new VeloBand Pulse. It's just... not working at all.
I'm certainly sorry to hear that. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
Oh, I think it's a fault. It seems broken. It just won't sync with my phone. I've tried turning it on and off, but nothing happens. I'm so confused by all this.
I see. So you believe the device might be defective because it won't sync. Let me just pull up your order details... one moment please.
Alright, I see you received the VeloBand Pulse 17 days ago. Is that correct?
Yes, that sounds about right. It was a gift. I'm just so overwhelmed. Can't you just help me? I don't want to spend hours on the phone with technical people.
Of course, I can help you with this. Let me just take a quick look at our return policy for you... one moment.
Okay, I've checked our policy, and it looks like you're in luck. All our items are eligible for return for a full refund within 90 days of delivery.
Oh, really? So I can just send it back? That's a huge relief!

Yes, absolutely. Since you're well within that 90-day period, I've just initiated the return process. I'm sending a pre-paid return label to the email on your account right now. You just need to print it, put it on the box, and drop it at a post office.
Wow, thank you so much, Isaac. That was so much easier than I thought it would be. I really appreciate it.
You're very welcome. We want to make sure you're satisfied. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
